summary.text: Chris Clagett is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 91, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A physician and retired U.S. Navy medical officer, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he moved to West Virginia in 2021.

paragraphs.text: Chris Clagett served in the U.S. Navy from 1986 to 2019, according to Ballotpedia.

He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maryland in 1985, an M.D. from the Uniformed Services University of the Health Sciences in 1992 and a graduate degree from Boston University in 1998.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said his medical specialty was preventive medicine and public health, and that he retired after 34 years of active service.
Clagett said he and his wife, Nancy, have been married 36 years and have three grown children.
He said his priorities include expanding school choice, including the Hope Scholarship, and reducing taxes and the size of state government.
